```{r}
match_labels_stats1b <- function(model) {
  case_match(
    model,
    "Full" ~ "None",
    "No landscape" ~ "Human impact and lanscape complexity",
    "No habitat" ~ "Habitat category",
    "No ecology" ~ "All except the number of points by community",
    "No n. points" ~ "Number of points by community",
    "Habitat controlled" ~ "None",
    "Null" ~ "All"
  )
}

build_stats1_selection_table(
  out_glm = targets::tar_read(
    models_stab_across_habitats,
    store = sel_store,
    branches = 1
  ),
  model_names = c("full", "no_landscape", "no_habitat", "no_npoints", "no_ecology", "null"),
  match_vars = match_labels_stats1b
) %>%
  dispatch_format(  # different formatting function depending on output document type
    other_fn = format_selection_kable,
    docx_fn = ifelse(running_from_pipeline(), NULL, format_selection_flex), # format_selection_flex is not defined in R/, but is never called from this document
    fixed_lbl = "Left out fixed effects"
  )


# format_selection_kable(anova_tables)
```
